snippet.title: Trine 6: Together in Time | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The next Trine adventure launches on Sept. 17, 2026 on Steam, Epic Games Store, Nintendo Switch™ & Nintendo Switch™ 2, PlayStation©5, and Xbox Series X|S! 

Trine 6: Together in Time is a co-op puzzle platformer for 1–4 players. Wit, timing, and teamwork collide as you solve perplexing puzzles, engage cunning creatures, and traverse perilous paths in the next adventure through Trine’s iconic fantasy world.

Wishlist today:

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2932260/Trine_6_Together_in_Time/
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/trine-6-76a3cf
Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/trine-6-together-in-time-switch/
Nintendo Switch 2: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/trine-6-together-in-time-switch-2/
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10071867
Xbox: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9plfqp2956ps
